cards.title: Weather report
cards.q: On a scale from sunny to stormy, how was your week, and what made it that way?

cards.title: Battery check
cards.q: How full is your tank right now: physically, mentally and socially?

cards.title: Week ahead
cards.q: What's one thing coming up this week that you're dreading, and one you're excited about?

cards.title: Did I get it right?
cards.q: Was there a moment this week you needed something from me that you didn't get?

cards.title: Load balance
cards.q: How did the chores, pets and errands feel this week: fair, or lopsided?

cards.title: One word
cards.q: Describe our week together in one word. Then explain the word.

cards.title: Small stuff
cards.q: Is there a small annoyance you've been holding onto that we should clear out now?

cards.title: Time together
cards.q: Did we get enough real time together this week, or mostly the same-room-different-screens kind?

cards.title: Money pulse
cards.q: Anything about spending, saving or plans coming up that's on your mind?

cards.title: Stress source
cards.q: What's taking up the most room in your head right now?

cards.title: Body check
cards.q: How have you been sleeping, eating and moving? Anything I can help with?

cards.title: Help wanted
cards.q: What's one thing I could take off your plate this week?

cards.title: Plan check
cards.q: Is there anything on the calendar we need to talk through before it sneaks up on us?

cards.title: Highlight reel
cards.q: What was your favorite moment with me this week?

cards.title: Proud of you
cards.q: What's something you did this week that you're proud of, even if it was small?

cards.title: Do-over
cards.q: If you could redo one moment from our week, which would it be and what would you change?

cards.title: Felt loved
cards.q: When did you feel most loved by me this week?

cards.title: Missed it
cards.q: When did you feel most disconnected from me this week?

cards.title: Growth spot
cards.q: Where do you think we've grown as a couple in the last few months?

cards.title: Pattern
cards.q: Is there a fight or friction that keeps coming back? What do you think is really under it?

cards.title: Learned
cards.q: What's something new you learned about me lately?

cards.title: Then and now
cards.q: What's something about us now that the early-days version of us would be surprised by?

cards.title: Lesson
cards.q: What did this week teach you about yourself?

cards.title: Thank you
cards.q: What's something I did recently that you never thanked me for, but noticed?

cards.title: Old habit
cards.q: Is there an old habit of yours that's crept back in? How do you feel about it?

cards.title: Five years out
cards.q: What does a really good life look like for us five years from now?

cards.title: Fear
cards.q: What's a fear about our future that you haven't said out loud yet?

cards.title: Childhood echo
cards.q: What's something from how you grew up that shows up in how you love me?

cards.title: Love language
cards.q: Has the way you most like to be loved changed since we met?

cards.title: Unsaid
cards.q: Is there something you've wanted to tell me but haven't found the right moment for?

cards.title: Dream
cards.q: What's a dream you have that you think I don't fully know about?

cards.title: Hard season
cards.q: When we hit a really hard season, what do you most need from me?

cards.title: Values
cards.q: What's one value you hope we always protect, no matter what changes?

cards.title: Who you're becoming
cards.q: Who are you trying to become right now, and how can I support that?

cards.title: Home
cards.q: What makes somewhere feel like home to you?

cards.title: Regret
cards.q: What's something you'd regret not doing together?

cards.title: Trust
cards.q: What's one thing I do that makes you trust me more?

cards.title: Legacy
cards.q: What do you want people to say about our relationship someday?

cards.title: Date roulette
cards.q: Plan our next date in 60 seconds. Go.

cards.title: Trip pick
cards.q: If we left tomorrow for anywhere for a week, where are we going?

cards.title: New hobby
cards.q: What's a hobby we should try together this month?

cards.title: Theme night
cards.q: Pick a theme for a night in: food, drinks, music and one rule.

cards.title: Top three
cards.q: Top three meals we've ever had together. Rank them.

cards.title: Adventure
cards.q: What's the most adventurous thing you'd want to do together?

cards.title: Playlist
cards.q: What song should be on the soundtrack of our relationship this month?

cards.title: Bucket list
cards.q: Add one thing to our couple's bucket list.

cards.title: Lottery
cards.q: We win a million dollars. What's the first thing we each buy, and the first thing we do together?

cards.title: Snow day
cards.q: A surprise snow day off together. Plan it hour by hour.

cards.title: Pet project
cards.q: If our animals each had a job, what would they be?

cards.title: Game night
cards.q: What game would we be unbeatable at as a team, and which one would end us?

cards.title: Sitcom
cards.q: If our relationship were a sitcom, what's the running joke?

cards.title: Impression
cards.q: Do your best impression of me when I'm hungry.

cards.title: Zombie plan
cards.q: Zombie apocalypse: who survives longer, and why is it obviously you?

cards.title: Roast
cards.q: Lovingly roast me in exactly two sentences.

cards.title: Pet's view
cards.q: What do you think our pets say about us when we're not home?

cards.title: Weird habit
cards.q: What's my weirdest habit that you've secretly grown to love?

cards.title: Swap
cards.q: If we swapped bodies for a day, what's the first thing you'd do as me?

cards.title: Movie title
cards.q: What would the title of a movie about our relationship be?

cards.title: Hill to die on
cards.q: What's the silliest thing we've ever argued about?

cards.title: Superpower
cards.q: If I had a completely useless superpower, what would it be?

cards.title: Reality show
cards.q: Which reality show would we absolutely ruin, and how?

cards.title: Villain era
cards.q: What would my villain origin story be?

cards.title: First look
cards.q: What was the first thing you found attractive about me?

cards.title: Outfit
cards.q: What's something I wear that drives you a little crazy?

cards.title: Flirt
cards.q: How do you like to be flirted with when we're out in public?

cards.title: Kiss
cards.q: Describe your favorite kind of kiss with me, without using the word 'good'.

cards.title: Tease
cards.q: Send me a text right now that you'd want to get from me.

cards.title: Memory
cards.q: What's a hot memory of us that pops into your head at random times?

cards.title: Compliment
cards.q: What's a compliment about my body you've never said out loud?

cards.title: Date night
cards.q: What would make our next date night feel a little dangerous in the best way?

cards.title: Attraction
cards.q: When do you find me most attractive that might surprise me?

cards.title: Look
cards.q: What look or touch from me tells you exactly what I'm thinking?

cards.title: Dare
cards.q: Truth or dare? Whoever's reading picks the dare.

cards.title: Secret signal
cards.q: Should we have a secret signal for 'let's leave early'? What is it?

cards.title: More of
cards.q: What's one thing you'd like more of in our sex life?

cards.title: Favorite
cards.q: What's your favorite thing I do in bed?

cards.title: Curious
cards.q: Is there something you've been curious to try together? No pressure, just talk.

cards.title: Mood setter
cards.q: What gets you in the mood fastest, and what kills it fastest?

cards.title: Timing
cards.q: Is our current rhythm of intimacy working for you? More, less, different times?

cards.title: Fantasy
cards.q: Share a fantasy, even a small one. We can decide later if it stays a fantasy.

cards.title: Touch
cards.q: Where do you love to be touched that I might be overlooking?

cards.title: After
cards.q: What makes you feel closest to me afterward?

cards.title: Yes, no, maybe
cards.q: Make a quick yes/no/maybe list together of three new things.

cards.title: Confidence
cards.q: What helps you feel most confident and comfortable with me?

cards.title: Slow down
cards.q: Would you like more slow, unhurried time together? What would that look like?

cards.title: Words
cards.q: What's something you'd like me to say more in the moment?

cards.title: Appreciation
cards.q: Name three things you appreciated about me this week.

cards.title: Favorite thing
cards.q: What's your favorite thing about us right now?

cards.title: Promise
cards.q: What's one small promise you'll make me for this week?

cards.title: Gratitude
cards.q: What's something about our life together you're grateful for today?

cards.title: Hype
cards.q: Tell me one thing you're excited to see me do or accomplish.

cards.title: Little thing
cards.q: What's a little thing I do that makes you feel cared for?

cards.title: Why me
cards.q: Remind me why you chose me.

cards.title: Proud
cards.q: What's something about me you're proud of?

cards.title: Next week
cards.q: What's one thing we can do next week to feel even closer?

cards.title: Love note
cards.q: Say the one sentence you'd want me to remember this week.

cards.title: Team
cards.q: What's one way we were a great team this week?

cards.title: Hug
cards.q: Give me a twenty-second hug and tell me what you're thinking during it.
